bio: 👋 Hi there! I'm Julia, a UI/UX Designer with a love for creating human-centered experiences. Throughout my career, I've worked across diverse industries, including proptech, fitnesstech, and edutech, driving impactful design solutions.

edu.title: Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science
edu.desc: During my senior year, I specialized in Game Development for my Bachelor's degree.

edu.title: Visual Art
edu.school: South Carolina Governor's School for the Arts and Humanities
edu.desc: I studied 1 year in South Carolina Governor's School for the Arts and Humanities with a focus on Visual Arts, developing my creative and design skills.

edu.title: Senior High School
edu.desc: I graduated high school in 2019 through remote learning through Penn Foster.

interests.label: Problem Solving
interests.desc: My favorite part of my job is the UX Research, investigating as well as coming up with online and offline solutions to a problem.

interests.label: Human-Centered Design
interests.desc: My principle is to always center the people who I am designing for and representing them well.

interests.label: Equity-Based Design
interests.desc: My goal is to be able to create products that serve a wide array of people, especially those with specialized needs.

interests.label: Sustainable Design
interests.desc: With the limited resources we have on the planet, my goal is to be efficient in utilizing the resources that are available to me.

hobbies.label: Gym
hobbies.desc: I try to be consistent and be active as much as I can! I always find that having a healthy body means a healthy mind as well.

hobbies.label: Cooking
hobbies.desc: I got into cooking due to the need to pivot towards a healthier lifestyle. I mainly try to cook high-protein and high-fiber, but I still love me a hearty lasagna!

hobbies.label: Baking
hobbies.desc: In my free time, I like to bake things like cookies and cakes. My specialty is a baked cheesecake topped with fresh fruit!

hobbies.label: Making Art
hobbies.desc: I like to dabble into anything creative, but my bread and butter is digital illustration. I also like sculpting, crafting cosplay props, and I hope to paint more!

hobbies.label: Gaming
hobbies.desc: I love playing JRPGs and cozy games! My current favorites would have to be Metaphor Refantazio and the Story of Seasons Series!

hobbies.label: Enjoying the slow life
hobbies.desc: I like to go on walks when the weather is cool, and to spend time with our family dog, Cookie. If you look around here, you might be able to see her :^)
